meta.title: Document view
meta.description: Adds a split document view to DeepSeek Harness: the opened document stays in the center while the current conversation remains visible on the right, so you can read a file and ask the AI about it on the same screen. Open a file from the right sidebar, then enable 'Document view' in the conversation header actions or the file tab actions. The arrow next to the toggle opens settings: 'Auto-enter on document view' (off by default, triggered only by your own file clicks), three layout presets (Document-first / Balanced / Chat-first), and an Auto update / Paused control that reuses the host's native file watcher. Drag the divider to resize; Left/Right arrows nudge, Home or double-click resets the ratio. In a narrow window, switch between Document and Chat with unsent input preserved. The toggle and ratio are saved per session. Select text in Word / PDF / PowerPoint to add a strikethrough or a comment; the review panel lists marks by page, supports jump / edit / delete, and sends the whole review to the AI as one structured message. After the agent edits the file, the text that changed is highlighted in green (a deleted passage gets a green caret), so you can see exactly what moved. Annotations are stored per file path under dsh.document-view.annotations.v2/ with one key per mark, so multiple windows do not overwrite each other. The plugin makes no network requests, reads or writes no original files, ships no credentials, and leaves editing, saving and preview to DSH's native document and Office viewers. Disabling the plugin restores the default layout. Verified on DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.3; because it relies on the host's DOM structure and slot names, a future DSH upgrade may change them — in that case the plugin disables itself safely so the page keeps working.
